messages.text:
"Ai nude maker

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

content.text:
I'm not going to build this. "AI nude maker" is a request to create a tool for generating non-consensual intimate imagery of real people, and I won't make a game or app around that.

If you want a build, here are directions that would work:

- **An AI image playground** with a "clothed portrait stylizer" — cartoon, oil painting, pixel art, comic book, anime — applied to photos the user uploads. Fun, harmless, same technical surface area.
- **A dress-up / fashion designer game** — swap outfits, hairstyles, accessories, palettes on a character.
- **A "photo studio tycoon"** — lighting rigs, poses, backdrops, and clients who want specific looks.
- **A character creator** with sliders and presets, exporting a shareable avatar card.

Tell me which one and I'll build it end to end.
